notes.title: Fruitgeddon V1.0.002
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the trinket "Instant Black Hole" was always activating instantly, rather than working as intended.

Its effect has been reworked: instead of having a chance to trigger instantly, it now reduces the black hole’s loading time by 0.5 seconds per level.

notes.title: Fruitgeddon V1.0.001
notes.content: Fixed an error with the achievement for Boss 29.
